subject: Dedicated pool expansion + co-term billing sync for ArborData renewal
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@arbordata.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@arbordata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Dedicated pool expansion + co-term proposal for ArborData renewal

Hi Sofia / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our discussion, ArborData is interested in adding additional reserved GPUs to your Redwood Dedicated pool and aligning the new capacity with your existing account renewal date (Mar 31, 2027). Summary of the proposal: 

- Add 8 x A100-equivalent GPUs to the reserved pool (dedicated capacity).
- Target go-live / provisioning: week of Jan 25, 2026 (pre-provisioned nodes, capacity validation).
- Co-term the added capacity so the new GPUs roll into the same renewal cycle that ends 2027-03-31.
- Add a throughput guarantee addendum: baseline throughput of 120 rps sustained, with burst headroom and an SLO-backed fallback to alternate model variants.

Attached: preliminary SOW and a pricing workbook that shows both monthly pro-rata and full-upfront billing options.

Quick asks so we can push to procurement: 
1) Would you prefer Redwood to deliver a PO amendment (modifying your existing PO) or to issue a separate PO that references the existing contract and the desired co-term?
2) Confirm preferred billing cadence: (A) pro-rated through 2027-03-31 + annual thereafter, or (B) pay full 12-month term upfront effective from provisioning date?

I’ve CC'd Marissa so she can confirm provisioning ETA with our infra team once procurement confirms approach. Ben is standing by to finalize the amendment language if you want a template.

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Account Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0122

Attachments: SOW-ArborData-2026Q1.pdf, Pricing-Redwood-Dedicated-2026Q1.xlsx

From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@arbordata.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool expansion + co-term proposal for ArborData renewal

Thanks Mina — this looks promising. A couple quick clarifications from procurement's side: 

- We prefer to have an amendment to our existing PO so the renewal date remains unchanged on our side; please provide an editable amendment template we can route through our contract team.
- For billing cadence we want pro-rata to align the new capacity into our current March 31 renewal, then annual invoices thereafter. Please provide exact pro-rata numbers for Jan 25 through Mar 31, 2026.
- Timeline: can you confirm the lead time to have the GPUs provisioned and tested? We need the capacity guaranteed for a load test scheduled the first week of Feb.

Adding Procurement <procurement@arbordata.com> on this thread so they can confirm internal PO flow and finance contact.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Head of ML Platforms | ArborData
sofia.ramos@arbordata.com

---
ArborData Procurement note: we typically require a PO number, insurer certificates (if higher value), and an explicit billing schedule before finance will sign. Will attach a formal PO once we have amendment language and pricing.

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@arbordata.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@arbordata.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool expansion + co-term proposal for ArborData renewal

Hi Sofia (and procurement team) —

Thanks — looping in the concrete numbers so procurement can route. We can absolutely deliver an amendment to your existing PO. I’ve attached: PO-Amendment-Template.docx (editable), and an updated SOW showing the throughput SLA language. Key commercial points (summary):

- One-time provisioning fee: $2,400 (covers validation, KV cache pre-warm, and model-compat smoke tests).
- Additional reserved capacity pricing: $9,600/month for 8 x A100-equivalent GPU reserved pool capacity (list price).
- Pro-rata calculation (provisioning on 2026-01-25 through 2027-03-31): we will bill 66/365 of the annual run-rate for the pro-rated period (spreadsheet attached shows month-by-month math).
- Billing options supported: monthly in arrears, quarterly invoicing, or annual upfront. You indicated preference for pro-rata into the existing March renewal + annual after that; we will prepare the invoice schedule accordingly.
- SLA addendum: 99.9% availability window for the reserved pool, with defined remediation (monthly credits) for missed SLOs. Throughput guarantee is scoped for typical inference workloads up to 512 tokens per request; larger sequences may require additional capacity.

Requested next items from ArborData: 
- Confirm preferred PO approach (amendment vs separate PO referencing contract).
- Provide PO number once procurement is ready (we'll reference in the amendment).

I'll leave Marissa to coordinate the infra provisioning calendar once procurement confirms.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Attachments: PO-Amendment-Template.docx, SOW-ArborData-2026Q1.pdf, Pricing-Redwood-Dedicated-2026Q1.xlsx

From: Procurement Team <procurement@arbordata.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 10:55:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool expansion + co-term proposal for ArborData renewal

Ben / Mina —

Thanks for the template and clear breakdown. We are prepared to move forward with an amendment to the existing PO. Please reference the following PO#: ARB-56789 in the amendment and routing paperwork.

Billing instructions we require: 
- Pro-rata charge for 2026-01-25 through 2027-03-31 to be invoiced on acceptance (we will pay this invoice net45).
- Subsequent annual invoices to align with the Mar 31 renewal cadence (we prefer annual upfront payments for budget certainty; finance will confirm after receiving the invoice).

Attached: formal PO (ArborData-PO-56789.pdf) and our internal procurement checklist for contract amendments. We will route the amendment for signatures once we have the editable doc with the PO referenced and the invoice schedule specified.

Approve provisioning timeline? Our infra team wants the nodes available for the Feb 1 performance test. Please confirm provisioning window.

Thanks,
ArborData Procurement
procurement@arbordata.com

Attachments: ArborData-PO-56789.pdf

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@arbordata.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated pool expansion + co-term proposal for ArborData renewal

Hi —

Acknowledged and thank you for PO ARB-56789. Next steps on our side: 
1) Ben — I will need the editable amendment with PO referenced (we can use the attached template you shared). Can you generate with PO ARB-56789 and the agreed pro-rata math so procurement can route?
2) Marissa — can you confirm provisioning window? ArborData has a load test scheduled for the first week of Feb; ideal provisioning date is Jan 25, 2026 so we have a buffer for validation.
3) Finance / Billing: we will prepare the pro-rata invoice for 2026-01-25 through 2027-03-31 and label it Invoice ARB-56789-PR. Per ArborData request we will also prepare the annual invoice aligned to Mar 31 once the amendment is fully signed.

Internal notes / tickets: 
- Infra ticket: INFRA-2298 (schedule GPU pool provisioning week of Jan 25).
- Billing ticket: BILL-1147 (prepare pro-rata invoice and subsequent Mar-31 annual invoice).

If procurement confirms routing, we will attach the editable amendment to the DocuSign envelope and send for signatures by EOD Mon Jan 19.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Mina Haddad
Account Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0122
